descriptionInUI: Runtime for the blue voice net. Inert unless the mission generator emits dcsRetribution.battlespaceNet (both 'Living battlespace' gates on, a blue AWACS in the mission, and the calls synthesized at generation -- Windows only). Each scheduled call transmits positionally from its real flight's group on the mission's AWACS frequency (trigger.action.radioTransmission, a small synthesized voice clip embedded in the miz), so tuning the briefed AWACS channel is enough to hear launch check-ins, pushes, on-station and RTB calls that match the actual air tasking order. A dead or despawned transmitter goes silent -- a call is only ever keyed from a live unit's position. Audio only: no gameplay-model change, no kills owned by Lua, and the player's own package is never voiced over.
